title: Score
description: A verdict scored against its outcome. Derived data: it is always recomputable from the verdict and the outcome, both of which are frozen. It carries the inputs it was computed from so a stored score that disagrees with them is detectable rather than authoritative.

probability.description: Copied from the verdict as scored, so the score can be checked without reading it back.

outcome.description: The outcome term: 1 if the verdict hit, 0 if it missed.

brier.description: (probability - outcome)^2. Bounded by 1 because probability is bounded by 0 and 1.
